I have used fillout for approx a year for my company's forms. Loved the product, gave us exactly what we needed, sleak and well designed forms. Until we accidentally identified a massive security gap that is. If you are using Airtable or Notion integration, if you have any forms on "Update", any logged in user can just change url ID and see not just any record from that table but it can actually see any ALL columns that you did not even pull to the form. For example, imagine a situation where your client can pull your other client's quote with condifential pricing. Yeah... I have informed Fillout of the issue and the answer was, well, this is kind of our design, dont use it then. We will be moving ASAP as soon as possible, but I taking the time to write this review to notify any business [...] taking the time to write this review to notify any business client that needs EU compliance that you CANNOT use Fillout to connect to any database tables that require private confidential. It's a great product to use with some unconsequential forms without PII or create forms only (e.g. contact us), but if you use Fillout for Updates with any table with PII, this will get you in GDPR breach. Fillout, cmon. Be better. [...] EM

Across these 15 G2 and Capterra reviews, Fillout averages 4.7/5 and 14 of 15 reviewers would recommend it. The recurring hero is the form builder itself: people repeatedly call it the best drag-and-drop they've used, praise how much is included even on the free plan, and highlight validation logic (regex included), pre-filled fields, and the PDF generator. Integrations are the other big win, with Airtable, Notion, Zapier, Slack, Google Drive and HubSpot all called out as smooth, and several reviewers say the team ships new features fast and responds quickly over chat.
